name: Late fee for delayed filing of returns
sectionOrRule: Section 47 of CGST Act, 2017 read with Notification No. 19/2021-Central Tax
description: Late fee payable for delay in furnishing returns under Section 39 (e.g. GSTR-3B). Rationalized under Amnesty / Notification 19/2021 with turnover-based caps.

parameters.sourceNote: Subject to turnover-based rationalization under Notification No. 19/2021-CT dated 01.06.2021.
